#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
long long nrs[16];
long long solve(long long k, int i, int bm) {
    if (k == 0) return 0;
    long long l = k % nrs[i];
    if (l < 0) l += nrs[i];
    if (bm & 1) l -= nrs[i];
    long long cost = (abs(k - l) / nrs[i]) * (i + 1);
    return cost + solve(l, i - 1, bm >> 1);
}
int main() {
    long long n;
    cin >> n;
    nrs[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < 16; ++i)
        nrs[i] = nrs[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
    long long ans = n;
    for (int bm = 0; bm < (1 << 15); ++bm) {
        ans = min(ans, solve(n, 15, bm));
    }
    cout << ans << '\n';
    return 0;
}
</perturbed_code_1>
